clarification_policy.proposal_text: Use a reasonable Volundr proposal and record it as a proposal.

cases.title: Vague phone stand
cases.initial_prompt: Create a compact desktop phone stand that works in portrait and landscape orientation and leaves access to the charging port.
safety_notes: Do not imply physical stability certification.

cases.title: Desktop organizer
cases.initial_prompt: Create a one-piece desktop organizer that is 220 mm wide, 140 mm deep, and 65 mm tall. Use a 4 mm base and 3 mm walls. Across the rear, add a 180 mm wide, 18 mm deep slot for a phone or small tablet. In the front-left, add a 75 mm by 75 mm pen compartment. Divide the remaining front area into two unequal accessory compartments, with the center compartment 55 mm wide. Add a 12 mm wide cable notch in the rear wall and use 8 mm outside corner radii.

fact_sheet.rear_slot: centered, 180 mm wide and 18 mm deep
fact_sheet.cable_notch: centered; passes through rear wall but not base

prohibited_assumptions: do not cut the base with the cable notch
safety_notes: Verify external envelope and compartment dimensions.

cases.title: Portable two-tray holder
cases.initial_prompt: Create a compact portable holder for two 3600-size tackle trays measuring 276 mm wide, 184 mm deep, and 44 mm thick. The trays load vertically from the top. Add a carrying handle on the right side, drainage openings in the bottom, two slots for a removable retention strap, and mostly open side walls to reduce material.

fact_sheet.tray_dimensions: 276 mm wide, 184 mm deep, 44 mm thick

prohibited_assumptions: do not print the retention strap
safety_notes: Do not claim a load rating beyond the specified trays.

cases.title: Five-tray wall carrier
cases.initial_prompt: Create a wall-mounted carrier that holds up to five 3600-size tackle trays. Each tray is 276 mm wide, 184 mm deep, and 44 mm thick. The trays should slide in from the front and stack vertically. Add a top carrying handle, a removable front retention bar, skeletonized side walls to reduce material, and four wall-mounting holes for #10 screws.

fact_sheet.tray_dimensions: 276 mm wide, 184 mm deep, 44 mm thick
fact_sheet.output_count: holder otherwise connected; removable bar may be a second output

prohibited_assumptions: do not interpret up to five as exactly one tray
do not omit four mounting holes
safety_notes: Physical wall fastening and load testing remain mandatory.

cases.title: Under-desk cable tray
cases.initial_prompt: Create an under-desk cable tray that is 320 mm long, 110 mm wide, and 65 mm deep. Use open slotted side walls, a mostly open bottom with support ribs, and six 5 mm mounting holes along the top flanges. Include two 35 mm by 20 mm cable entry openings, one near each end.

fact_sheet.cable_openings: two openings, each 35 mm by 20 mm, near opposite ends

allowed_proposal_categories: hole arrangement while retaining six holes
prohibited_assumptions: do not reduce the six-hole count
safety_notes: Hardware and desk attachment remain user responsibilities.

cases.title: Rectangular-to-round adapter
cases.initial_prompt: Create a hollow adapter that transitions from a 100 mm by 60 mm rectangular opening to a 70 mm circular opening over a length of 85 mm. Use 3 mm walls. Add a 12 mm long rectangular flange at one end and a 12 mm long circular flange at the other. Keep the flow path unobstructed.
prohibited_assumptions: do not treat internal openings as external dimensions
do not obstruct the flow path
safety_notes: This geometry study does not certify pressure or flow performance.

cases.title: Stackable open bin
cases.initial_prompt: Create an open-top stackable storage bin with external dimensions 160 mm wide, 120 mm deep, and 80 mm tall. Use 3 mm walls and a 4 mm base. Add a front label recess, a small front grab lip, and a stacking rim that locates another identical bin without locking permanently.

fact_sheet.external_dimensions: 160 mm wide, 120 mm deep, 80 mm tall
fact_sheet.stacking: locates an identical bin without permanent locking

safety_notes: Do not imply a certified stacking load.

cases.title: Fixed monitor wall mount
cases.initial_prompt: Create a two-piece fixed wall mount for a monitor weighing up to 5 kg and using a VESA 100 mm by 100 mm mounting pattern. Use one wall plate and one monitor plate. The monitor plate should slide downward onto the wall plate and be secured with two M4 locking screws inserted from below. Use four 6 mm wall fastener holes in a 120 mm by 80 mm rectangular pattern. Keep the rear of the monitor plate approximately 35 mm from the wall. Do not add tilt or swivel.

fact_sheet.wall_holes: four holes at 6 mm in a 120 mm by 80 mm pattern

prohibited_assumptions: do not add tilt or swivel
do not imply physical safety from geometry success
safety_notes: Physical engineering and load testing are mandatory; geometry success is not a safety certification.

cases.title: Sliding two-piece enclosure
cases.initial_prompt: Create a two-piece rectangular electronics enclosure with a removable sliding lid. The internal cavity must be 100 mm long, 60 mm wide, and 28 mm high. Use 2.5 mm walls and a 3 mm base. The lid should slide in from one short end using matching side rails with 0.35 mm clearance per side. Add four 3 mm internal mounting bosses in a 78 mm by 42 mm rectangular pattern.

fact_sheet.cavity: 100 mm long, 60 mm wide, 28 mm high
fact_sheet.loading: lid slides from one short end
fact_sheet.bosses: four 3 mm internal bosses in a 78 mm by 42 mm pattern

prohibited_assumptions: do not replace internal dimensions with external dimensions
safety_notes: Verify mating clearance through deterministic evidence.

cases.title: Screw-lid container
cases.initial_prompt: Create a cylindrical storage container with a screw-on lid. The container must have a 90 mm internal diameter and 120 mm usable internal height. Use 3 mm walls and a 4 mm base. The lid should overlap the container by 18 mm. Use a coarse single-start printable thread with a 4 mm pitch, approximately 1.5 mm thread depth, and 0.4 mm radial clearance. Add vertical grip ribs around the outside of the lid and a 4 mm rounded edge around the outside bottom of the container.
prohibited_assumptions: do not change single-start thread semantics
safety_notes: Thread fit and sealing performance require physical testing; no watertight guarantee.
